#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
bool vis[1010101];

int main()
{
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    long long ans = (k == 1 ? (long long)p : 1LL);

    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i)
    {
        if (!vis[i])
        {
            stack<long long> st;
            st.push(i);

            while (!st.empty())
            {
                long long v = st.top();
                st.pop();

                if (!vis[v])
                {
                    vis[v] = true;
                    st.push((v * k) % p);
                }
            }

            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
bitset<1010101> vis;

void dfs(long long v, int k, int p)
{
    if (!vis.test(v))
    {
        vis.set(v);
        dfs((v * k) % p, k, p);
    }
}

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp)
{
    base %= MOD;
    long long res = 1;

    while (exp > 0)
    {
        if (exp & 1)
            res = (res * base) % MOD;

        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }

    return res;
}

int main()
{
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    int components = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i)
    {
        if (!vis.test(i))
        {
            dfs(i, k, p);
            ++components;
        }
    }

    long long ans = mod_pow(p, components + (k == 1 ? 1 : 0));
    cout << ans << '\n';

    return 0;
}
